title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本标题“井底之蛙”，画面中有一只绿色的小青蛙坐在井底，周围有水和花朵，背景是井壁的石砖纹理。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 一只青蛙住在一口废井里，它高兴时在井里跳来跳去，天热了在水中游上游下，觉得很快活。
page_text_en: A frog lives in an abandoned well. When it's happy, it jumps around in the well. When it's hot, it swims up and down in the water, feeling very happy.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了一只青蛙住在废井中，它在井里快乐地跳跃和游泳，感到非常快活。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: “我是井里的主人，多么逍遥自在，”它正在自得其乐的时候，忽然听到有人在叫它。
page_text_en: "I am the master of the well, how carefree and free I am," it was enjoying itself when suddenly it heard someone calling it.
summary_zh: 青蛙在井底自得其乐，认为自己是井的主人，正享受着逍遥自在的生活，突然听到有人在叫它。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 它抬起头向井口一看，只见一只大海龟的头，几乎遮去了井口上的半边天，只听见大海龟在问它，“青蛙老弟，你见过大海吗？"
page_text_en: It lifted its head and looked up at the well's opening, only to see the head of a giant turtle, which almost covered half the sky above the well. It heard the turtle asking, "Frog brother, have you ever seen the sea?"
summary_zh: 青蛙抬头看见一只大海龟从井口探下头，大海龟询问它是否见过大海。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: “大海？有我的井大吗？海龟老兄，欢迎你下井来做客。”
page_text_en: “The sea? Is it bigger than my well? Brother turtle, welcome to come down the well as my guest.”
summary_zh: 青蛙在井底对来访的海龟表示欢迎，并自信地询问大海是否比自己的井更大。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh:
大海龟被它说动了心，真想下井去看看，可是，它左腿
还没跨进井去，右腿的膝盖已被井栏绊住了。
page_text_en:
The big turtle was convinced by its words and really wanted to go down the well to take a look. However, its left leg
hadn't even stepped into the well yet, and its right knee was already caught by the well's rim.
summary_zh: 大海龟被井底之蛙说服，想下井一探究竟，但右腿膝盖被井栏卡住，无法进入。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 于是，大海龟只好附在井口上告诉青蛙，海有多大，多深，多广。
page_text_en: So, the big turtle had to lean over the well's mouth and tell the frog how big, deep, and vast the sea was.
summary_zh: 大海龟因无法进入井中，只能在井口向青蛙描述大海的广阔、深邃和浩瀚。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh: 青蛙这才知道，井外还有这么大的天地，它又惊奇又惭愧，感到自己的见识太渺小了。
page_text_en: The frog finally realized that there was such a vast world beyond the well. It felt both surprised and ashamed, realizing how narrow its knowledge was.
summary_zh: 青蛙在听完海龟对大海的描述后，意识到井外世界广阔，感到惊奇和惭愧，认识到自己的见识非常有限。

title_en: The Frog at the Bottom of the Well
page_text_ocr_zh:
思考
这个成语故事的寓意是：
井底的青蛙只能看到井口
那么大的一块天。比喻见识狭窄的人。
page_text_en:
Think
The moral of this idiom story is:
The frog at the bottom of the well can only see a sky as big as the well's opening. It metaphorically refers to people with narrow vision.
summary_zh: 本页通过一只思考的狮子形象，总结了‘井底之蛙’成语的寓意：比喻见识狭窄的人。
